title: EasyTutor Completion Register
purpose: Machine-readable measure of completeness and readiness for the four milestones.

scoring.formula: milestone score = sum(status_score * priority_weight) / sum(priority_weight) over rows naming that milestone
scoring.ready_rule: READY iff score >= 0.80 AND no P0 row is open AND every critical_path row is VERIFIED-IN-CI
scoring.open_definition: a row is open unless its status starts with VERIFIED

non_goals: Payments, commerce and subscriptions in v1 (archive/lib/commerce stays archived).
Play Store publication in v1; signed APK for device proof only.
Free-text essay marking and image-based question solving in v1.
Live Ollama inference as a default rail; it remains opt-in and unreachable by default.
Rewriting history or rotating credentials in an agent session.

evidence_formats.file:<path>[:<line>]: path must exist; used by VERIFIED-* rows
evidence_formats.test:<path>: test file must exist; used by VERIFIED-* rows
evidence_formats.run:<https-url>: CI run URL; required by VERIFIED-IN-CI rows
evidence_formats.command:<text>: runnable acceptance command, no path check

rows.title: Curriculum priority and reviewer
rows.recommended_default: KCSE first, then Kenya TVET automotive, then one university pack; Daniel reviews
rows.cost_of_delay: Without a reviewer packs stay DRAFT and F3 cannot be claimed.

rows.title: Performance targets
rows.recommended_default: Keep existing budgets; add a mobile Lighthouse floor of 60, ratchet to 80 after a measured baseline
rows.cost_of_delay: No mobile gate means repeated unmeasured regressions; delay keeps F8 unverifiable.

rows.title: PWA vs APK vs Play Store
rows.recommended_default: PWA for pilot, signed APK for device proof, Play Store deferred
rows.cost_of_delay: Play Store needs legal/assets and is not on the critical path to learning proof.

rows.title: AI budget
rows.recommended_default: Cap 200 calls/user/day and 1000 tokens/call; budget for 10 learners then re-plan at 25
rows.cost_of_delay: Without a tier decision the pilot can exhaust free quota mid-cohort.
